create_inverse_bijector: create an Inverse bijector by wrapping an existing bijector to swap forward and inverse transformations
run_forward_on_inverse: run the forward method on an Inverse bijector to compute the inverse transformation of the wrapped bijector
run_inverse_on_inverse: run the inverse method on an Inverse bijector to compute the original forward transformation of the wrapped bijector
compute_forward_log_det_jacobian: compute the forward log determinant of the jacobian using an Inverse bijector which delegates to the wrapped bijector inverse
check_same_as_inverse: check if two Inverse bijectors are the same by comparing their wrapped bijectors using the same_as method
